title: The monsoon's sails
summary: Dhows cross the Indian Ocean the way they did for two thousand years: out with the summer wind, home with the winter's. Drag the year, or touch a port to send its ships out.

doorway.label: The monsoon's sails: a dhow in the Arabian Sea

whatsNew.title: The monsoon's sails
whatsNew.what: A year at the foot that is also the globe's season. Dhows sail only when the wind blows their way; the wind as streaks.
whatsNew.ask: Did you notice the ground's season change with the year?
